answer: Proof-of-stake consensus functions as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to earn influence. An attacker hitting the nadir of protocol security must amass significant assets, turning the network into a steep economic knoll rather than an ivory tower of free entry. By anchoring identity to staked value rather than ephemeral computational power, the system ensures that spinning up infinite fake identities imposes a prohibitive financial cost on adversaries.
